datasets.title: Genome-scale methylome profiling of human pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas (Illumina methylation beadchips) and mouse chromaffin cells (RRBS)
datasets.summary: This SuperSeries is composed of the SubSeries listed below.
datasets.study_design: 人类副神经节瘤组织甲基化谱分析，比较良恶性与基因突变特征
datasets.relevance_reason: 直接使用145例人类副神经节瘤组织样本进行甲基化分析
datasets._49895c: 数据来自SOGEN索臻标注语料·sogentech.com·更多学科与专题私域群持续更新·微信bioinformaticsboy
datasets._d036e3: SOGEN·索臻·标注这道工序我们替你做了·增量更新加群·公众号光热生物/科研风向标/组学料理

evidence.relevant: 标题以paraganglioma为研究对象，样本主要为paraganglioma组织（145例），进行甲基化谱分析，两轴均满足。
evidence.sequencing_type: SuperSeries含两种技术：人类样本用Illumina甲基化芯片(Illumina methylation beadchips)，产出beta值，为methylation array；小鼠嗜铬细胞用RRBS(Bisulfite-Seq + Reduced Representation + MspI消化)，非全基因组亚硫酸盐测序，判为通用methylation。
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本级字段无任何生存时间或状态信息，下游无法做生存分析
evidence.treatment: 无药物干预对照轴，核心比较为肿瘤良恶性与基因突变
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 甲基化平台非表达平台，且正常对照仅5例达不到≥3v3
evidence.correlation: 甲基化平台非表达定量平台，无法做表达相关性分析
evidence.sample_source: 人类样本：冰冻副神经节瘤/正常肾上腺髓质，直接提DNA即测→tissue。小鼠样本：chromaffin cell line，在DMEM+10%FBS中培养→cell_line。无技术对照。

datasets.title: Genome-scale methylome profiling of pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas with Illumina Infinium 27k Human Methylation arrays
datasets.summary: Genome-scale DNA methylation was analyzed in a large cohort of pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas (PCC/PGL). Consensus clustering identified 3 stable clusters significantly associated with expression subgroups, gene mutations, and clinical parameters.
datasets.overall_design: Bisulfite-converted DNA from 145 fresh frozen PCC/PGL and 3 normal adrenal medulla samples were hybridized to Illumina Infinium 27k Human Methylation BeadChips.
datasets.relevance_reason: 纳入145例副神经节瘤/嗜铬细胞瘤样本（索臻(SOGEN)·免费流传·想持续拿到更新就留在群里·入群20元只为挡广告号·微信bioinformaticsboy）

evidence.relevant: 145例 paraganglioma 组织样本进行甲基化谱分析，研究主体即 paraganglioma 亚型与突变关联，满足主体轴和样本轴。
evidence.sequencing_type: Bisulfite-converted genomic DNA hybridized to Illumina Infinium 27k BeadChips, array-based methylation profiling with BeadStudio.
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本级characteristics无生存时间/状态字段，无法进行生存分析
evidence.treatment: 研究无药物干预对照轴，核心比较为甲基化聚类与基因突变关联
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 甲基化芯片非表达平台，不符合差异分析平台要求
evidence.correlation: 甲基化芯片非表达平台，无法进行表达定量相关性分析
evidence.sample_source: GSM显示两批材料：145例paraganglioma和3例normal adrenal medulla，均为新鲜冰冻实体组织，直接提取DNA进行甲基化芯片，未分选特定细胞类型也未体外培养，故归tissue。

datasets.title: Epigenome analysis of pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma samples
datasets.summary: Genome wide DNA methylation profiling of pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma samples carrying different mutations. The Illumina Infinium EPIC Human DNA methylation Beadchip was used to obtain DNA methylation profiles.
datasets.overall_design: Bisulphite converted DNA from the 31 samples were hybridised to the Illumina Infinium EPIC Human Methylation Beadchip
datasets.study_design: 副神经节瘤/嗜铬细胞瘤组织及对照样本，DNA甲基化芯片分析

evidence.relevant: 20例PCPG肿瘤组织构成核心样本，研究不同突变亚型的甲基化谱，主体与样本均直接匹配目标疾病。
evidence.sequencing_type: 亚硫酸氢盐转化基因组DNA后，与Illumina Infinium EPIC甲基化芯片杂交，信号由GenomeStudio处理，为典型methylation array技术路线
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本级元数据仅有性别和样本类型，缺乏生存时间及状态字段，下游无法做生存分析
evidence.treatment: 核心比较为不同DNMT3A突变状态与野生型，无药物处理对照轴
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 平台为甲基化芯片，非mRNA表达平台，无法做基因表达差异分析
evidence.correlation: 甲基化芯片非表达平台，且独立患者样本数有限（仅淋巴细胞及肿瘤），无法做表达相关性分析
evidence.sample_source: GSM分三批：淋巴细胞（外周血混合群体，未分选亚型）→blood；HeLa细胞系→cell_line；嗜铬细胞瘤/副神经节瘤实体组织（未分离特定细胞）→tissue。无技术对照需剔除。

datasets.title: Characterization and metabolic synthetic lethal testing in a new model of SDH-loss familial pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma
datasets.summary: This SuperSeries is composed of the SubSeries listed below.
datasets.study_design: SDH缺失小鼠胚胎成纤维细胞模型，doxycycline诱导后RNA-seq和RRBS分析不同时间点的基因表达与甲基化变化。
datasets.relevance_reason: 建立SDHC敲除细胞模型模拟家族性副神经节瘤

evidence.relevant: 标题明确为SDH缺失家族性副节瘤新模型研究；样本为Sdhc敲除的MEFs模拟该病驱动突变，属疾病模型。
evidence.sequencing_type: RRBS样本：Bisulfite-Seq+Reduced Representation，非全基因组→methylation；RNA-Seq样本：cDNA文库，默认mRNA-seq。多技术按字母序组合。
evidence.survival_analysis: 全部28个样本均为永生化小鼠胚胎成纤维细胞系，无人类患者样本，无法做患者生存分析
evidence.treatment: doxycycline仅用于诱导Cre介导的Sdhc基因敲除，属基因操作工具，无药物治疗对照轴
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 对照为Sdhc fl/wt基因型细胞系，属遗传工程模型对照，非独立健康组织个体，且为体外细胞
evidence.correlation: 所有样本均为细胞系，无疾病患者组织样本，无法满足>15例独立疾病患者的要求
evidence.sample_source: 所有28个样本的cell line字段均为'immortalized mouse embryonic fibroblast cell line'，source/标题显示均为该永生化细胞系体外培养及其诱导后不同时间点产物，未涉及体内移植，判为cell_line。

datasets.title: Genome-scale methylome profiling of pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas with Illumina HumanMethylation450 arrays
datasets.summary: Genome-scale DNA methylation was analyzed in a cohort of paragangliomas to identify DNA methylation changes.
datasets.overall_design: Bisulfite converted DNA from 22 fresh frozen paragangliomas and 2 normal adrenal medulla samples were hybridized to Illumina HumanMethylation450 BeadChips.
datasets.study_design: 22例副神经节瘤和2例正常肾上腺髓质样本的Illumina 450K甲基化芯片分析

datasets.title: iMEF SDHC-loss RRBS time course
datasets.summary: We have developed a tet-inducible immortalized mouse embryonic fibroblast (iMEF) cell culture model of SDH-loss paraganglioma/pheochromocytoma in which silencing gene rearrangement of the Sdhc floxed allele is driven by doxycycline-dependent expression of cre-recombinase from a tet-inducible promoter (R26M2rtTA/+;TetOcre;Sdhcfl/fl).  Using this model and an isogenic Sdhc wt control line (R26M2rtTA/+;TetOcre;Sdhcfl/wt), we have characterized the time-course of Sdhc gene rearrangement, protein loss, and succinate accumulation following induction with doxycycline.  Using reduced representation bisulfite sequencing (RRBS), we have quantified changes in the genome-wide distribution of cytosine/5’-methyl-cytosine due to succinate accumulation using our Sdhc -/- cell line.  Through a time-course experimental design, we have grown R26M2rtTA/+;TetOcre;Sdhcfl/fl (experimental) and R26M2rtTA/+;TetOcre;Sdhcfl/wt (control) iMEFs in standard DMEM media containing 10% FBS and quantified DNA methylation changes in these cells as a function of time after triggering SDHC gene rearrangement via doxycycline exposure.
datasets.overall_design: Included in this dataset are single replicate RRBS time course data for experimental (R26M2rtTA/+;TetOcre;Sdhcfl/fl) and control (R26M2rtTA/+;TetOcre;Sdhcfl/wt) cell lines at days 0, 5, 9, 12,16, and 20 after induction with doxycycline.
